label: Deflicker
blurb: Steadies brightness that pumps and flickers from frame to frame: time lapses where the camera's exposure jumps, old film with uneven frames, lights on a mains supply, a cloud passing a window too fast. Each frame is measured against the frames just before it and nudged back to their level, so the flicker goes and slow real changes such as a sunset are kept. Whole picture corrects the frame as one; By area handles flicker that is stronger in one part of the frame.
